verdict.rationale: AI Gateway supports rate limiting (fixed/sliding, per-request-count thresholds) and fallback/retry across providers or models, which helps mitigate rate-limit errors by rerouting traffic, and dynamic routing can enforce quotas per user/team. However, there is no explicit documented feature for spreading requests across multiple API keys for the same provider or for queuing throttled requests instead of failing/rerouting — the evidence shows rate limiting blocks/limits traffic and fallbacks switch providers, not key-rotation or request queuing. missing for 10: multi-key rotation/load-balancing across provider keys, explicit request queuing (vs. hard rate-limit cutoff or fallback), and independent evidence of this pattern working in production.
